name: Kentucky State University
tuition_note: 2026-27 resident tuition & fees from kysu.edu/finance-and-administration/student-accounts/tuition-and-fees.php (Fee Schedule 2026-27). Page lists per-semester amounts: resident tuition $4,415/sem = $8,830/yr plus recurring mandatory fees per semester (Activity $175, Asset Preservation $150, Safety & Security $52, Technology $156 = $533/sem = $1,066/yr) plus Homecoming fee $60 (fall only) = $9,956/yr tuition & fees. Housing $5,700/yr is room only, using a representative standard double room ($2,850/sem x2, e.g. Chandler/Combs/Kentucky halls) from the same page; other rooms range from double $2,500/sem to single $6,000/sem. Board (meal plans) not included in housing figure.
